name: Calibration Ladder League
loop: Play 3-minute masked-chart rounds giving probabilities; season rating moves by Brier skill; top of each division is promoted at week end.
hook: Rating climbs only by being honest about uncertainty; weekly promotion stakes.
risk: Unlimited play may feed compulsive grinding; cap rated rounds.

name: Friends Weekly Table
loop: Invite up to eight friends to a private weekly table; each plays the same five masked charts and the table ranks by total score on Sunday.
hook: Same puzzle for all, banter in a small group, fresh table every week.
risk: Hit rate alone rewards lucky coin flips; pair with calibration.

name: Soft Reset Seasons
loop: Twelve-week season; at season end rating compresses halfway toward the median so veterans and newcomers meet again; three rated rounds a day.
hook: A fresh race every quarter without erasing your history.
risk: Reset may feel punishing; show lifetime calibration separately.

name: Promotion By Calibration
loop: Ten-rank divisions of thirty players; each week the best calibrated move up and the most overconfident move down, judged on a reliability curve not luck.
hook: Promotion rewards being right about how right you are.
risk: Complex score may confuse; needs one-line explainer.

name: Volatility Season
loop: Themed season where every round samples high-volatility historical windows; players draw ranges and are scored on coverage versus width.
hook: Season theme changes the feel; narrow honest ranges beat wild guesses.
risk: Volatile themes could glamorize risk; label as practice only.

name: Quiet Tape Season
loop: A low-volatility themed season where drifts are tiny and the skill is resisting overreaction; rating rewards refusing to be confident.
hook: Rewards restraint, the opposite of a casino hook.
risk: May bore; reward cosmetic for patience.

name: Division Ladder Weekly
loop: Thirty-player divisions play one 3-minute set of eight charts per week; top five promote, bottom five drop, scores normalized to the division.
hook: One focused session a week, clear stakes, no daily pressure.
risk: Rank_vs_field punishes quiet divisions; use bounded zero-sum.

name: Season Recap Card
loop: At season end generate a recap card: calibration curve, best call, worst miss, and rating arc; no money figures, only percentages.
hook: A shareable keepsake of your forecasting personality.
risk: Shared cards must carry the not-advice line and avoid bragging implications.

name: Clubs Of Forecasters
loop: Join a club of up to fifty; each member's daily score adds to a club pool, clubs compete in a seasonal table with the median counted, not the sum.
hook: Belonging and a team to not let down.
risk: Social pressure to play daily; no streak penalties.

name: Median Club Wars
loop: Clubs are ranked by the median member score so one star cannot carry; low-activity members still count at their last score.
hook: Everyone matters; inclusive team stakes.
risk: Free-riding resentment; show per-member contribution privately.

name: Season Of Surprises
loop: Themed season sampling windows with sudden gaps; log scoring means overconfident misses cost a lot, so players learn to hold back probability.
hook: Dramatic misses teach the tails; stakes feel real without money.
risk: Log loss can feel harsh; clip penalty and explain.

name: Weekly Gauntlet Cup
loop: Friends enter a bracket; each week one 3-minute set decides head-to-head by calibration; losers drop to a consolation table, nobody is eliminated.
hook: Bracket drama with a no-elimination floor.
risk: Head-to-head variance on small samples; use 12 charts.

name: Rolling Rating Window
loop: No hard seasons; rating is a rolling ninety-day calibration window so old results fade smoothly and recent form shows.
hook: Always a fresh race without a cliff reset.
risk: Unlimited play may encourage cherry-picking sessions.

name: Relegation Safety Net
loop: Division relegation needs two bad weeks in a row, and dropped players keep a protected shield for one week, so a bad streak never feels fatal.
hook: Low-shame competition keeps players returning.
risk: Shield could be gamed by sandbagging; require minimum rounds.

name: Anonymized Record League
loop: Each round shows an anonymised verified closed trade entry; predict whether it ended in profit and by how much band; season rating tracks calibration.
hook: Learn what real verified records look like, losses included.
risk: Re-identification of traders; strong anonymity and consent needed.

name: Earnings Season Cup
loop: A themed season built from historical earnings-gap windows; predict the direction after the report with a probability and a size band.
hook: Calendar-flavoured theme with a clear dramatic moment per round.
risk: Could look like trading signals; mask names and dates.

name: Season Pass Of Lessons
loop: Each season has a theme with twelve lesson chapters; completing rounds unlocks a short plain-language note on a market concept, never a tip.
hook: Season-long learning arc with a finished codex.
risk: Lessons must not drift into advice; owner-reviewed text.

name: Overconfidence Meter Season
loop: Friends league where the weekly winner is the most improved calibration versus their own last week, not the best raw score.
hook: Beginners can win; self-competition inside a group.
risk: Improvement metric can be sandbagged; use 4-week baseline.

name: Underdog Division
loop: New players start in a rookie division with its own table for their first season, then merge into the main ladder with a placement rating.
hook: A fair start, no drowning among veterans.
risk: Smurf accounts; placement must be hard to reset.

name: Streakless Season
loop: Season counts only your best ten rounds out of any number played, so a missed day costs nothing and extra play beyond ten adds nothing.
hook: Anti-grind design that respects time.
risk: Weak urgency; may reduce retention.

name: Regime Season
loop: Each season fixes a hidden market regime label (trend, chop, crash-recovery); rounds sample from it and players infer the regime by season end for a bonus.
hook: A season-long mystery layered over daily rounds.
risk: Inference bonus adds complexity; keep it optional.

name: Pair Of Friends Duel Week
loop: Challenge a friend to a best-of-five week; each day a new chart for both, closest probability wins the day; results roll into a friend ladder.
hook: Personal rivalry with a built-in rematch.
risk: Harassment in direct challenges; mute and block needed.

name: Seasonal Codex Of Misses
loop: Season records your five most overconfident misses into a codex with the pattern behind each; end-of-season card shows lessons learned.
hook: Turns mistakes into a collectible story of growth.
risk: Shame framing; present neutrally.

name: Pre-Season Placement
loop: Before each season, a 3-minute placement drill of twelve charts seeds your division from calibration, with uncertainty shown as a band.
hook: Quick start and honest initial placement.
risk: Single drill noisy; show confidence band.

name: Weekly Roguelike League
loop: One seeded paper-trade run per week for the whole friend league, same synthetic path and same random events; rank by risk-adjusted paper return.
hook: Everyone faces the same dungeon; compare routes.
risk: Paper P&L rewards risk-taking; use risk-adjusted score.

name: Banded Divisions By Variance
loop: Divisions are made from similar stated confidence habits so cautious and bold players compete with peers; promotion by calibration within band.
hook: Fair comparisons by temperament.
risk: Gaming bands by faking caution; lock band per season.

name: Friends Season Almanac
loop: Each day the league swipes one masked chart; the almanac page shows each friend's calls, who agreed, and weekly consensus accuracy.
hook: Light daily ritual with group memory.
risk: Herd copying others' calls; reveal only after lock.

name: Crowd Versus Me
loop: After each call you see the crowd's average probability; season rating records whether you beat or lost to the crowd, rewarding independent correct calls.
hook: Competitive framing against the wisdom of the crowd.
risk: Contrarian farming; require lock-before-reveal.

name: Season Map Of Weeks
loop: A twelve-week season as a board map; each week is a node with a different challenge type, and completion paints the map for the recap.
hook: Visible progress through a season journey.
risk: Sunk-cost pull to finish; allow skipping nodes.

name: Mid-Season Draft
loop: Friends draft anonymous masked chart cards for a weekly roster; each card plays out over the week; league ranks rosters by combined paper return.
hook: Fantasy-sports feel using masked history.
risk: Reads like stock picking; masked and historical only.

name: Promotion Playoff
loop: Players on the promotion bubble enter a 3-minute playoff of ten charts at week end; the best calibration in the playoff takes the last promotion slot.
hook: Clutch moments for borderline players.
risk: Pressure moment; offer a skip with no penalty.

name: Season Of Interval Honesty
loop: Season rating based on whether your 80 percent ranges actually contain the outcome eight times in ten; both too wide and too narrow lose points.
hook: A clear, intuitive target to hit.
risk: Players may not grasp coverage; add a live hit tally.

name: League Of Ghosts
loop: Race the saved answers of your division rivals as ghosts on the same chart set; your weekly placement is computed against all ghosts at once.
hook: Play any time yet still compete asynchronously.
risk: Replaying the same set to learn answers; seeds fresh weekly.

name: Season Chronicle Cards
loop: Each week an auto-written chronicle card summarizes your league week: rank movement, best call, and a calibration emoji-free badge; share as a link.
hook: Light weekly narrative to share with friends.
risk: Cards must not show money or imply advice.

name: Hall Of Honest Misses
loop: Season honours go not just to top scorers but to the best-calibrated low-confidence players, with a hall page for honesty awards.
hook: A second, different prestige path.
risk: Awards could be farmed with constant 50 percent; require dispersion.

name: Sponsorless Charity Season
loop: Season themed around a neutral good cause shown as a goal bar; league activity unlocks nothing monetary, only a thank-you page.
hook: Collective purpose beyond rank.
risk: Any donation link would be real-money; keep purely symbolic.

name: Seasonal Boss Chart
loop: Each week a notoriously tricky masked chart is the boss; the whole league submits a probability and the crowd's collective error is a shared score.
hook: Cooperative tension against a hard puzzle.
risk: Boss framing may encourage fixating; one attempt only.

name: Rank Decay Honesty
loop: Rating shows an uncertainty band that widens when you are idle and narrows with play; rank uses the lower bound, so only sustained skill tops.
hook: Lower-bound ranking mirrors the app's own record trust rules.
risk: Idle widening may nag; no push reminders.

name: Study Group Season
loop: A small club picks a concept each week; all play rounds tagged with it, then write one line on what they noticed; best calibration gets a codex stamp.
hook: Learning in company, light reflection.
risk: Free text moderation; reuse thesis moderation list.

name: Time-Zone Leagues
loop: Divisions are grouped by local play window so the daily set lands at breakfast, lunch or evening; rank within window, merged weekly.
hook: Daily ritual fits your timezone.
risk: Hit rate is noisy; add calibration weight.

name: Season Trophy Shelf
loop: Each season leaves a permanent shelf item colored by your final division; cosmetic only, shown on your profile beside real verified stats, clearly labelled game.
hook: Collection across many seasons.
risk: Game badge beside verified record may mislead; separate label.

name: Verified Trader Mirror League
loop: Given an anonymised verified trade's entry context, guess its outcome band; league rewards calibration on how often real traders win, teaching base rates.
hook: Real distributions, not stories.
risk: Trader consent and k-anonymity needed before any use.

name: Bear Season
loop: Themed season sampling falling-market windows; most players start biased toward up, so well-calibrated downside awareness climbs the table.
hook: Theme exposes a common bias in your own record.
risk: May tilt toward fear; add a balanced bull season next.

name: Seasonal Bias Report
loop: End of season computes your up-bias, overconfidence and recency tilt from your calls and gives a plain report card with one drill per bias.
hook: Personalised self-knowledge that earns the next season.
risk: Report is about forecasting habits, not advice.

name: League Of Analysts Notes
loop: Each member writes a thirty-word reason with their weekly calls; after reveal, friends vote which reason was most informative, adding a bonus.
hook: Rewards reasoning, not just outcomes.
risk: Reasons may read as advice; moderation and no real names.

name: Auction Of Confidence
loop: Each week you get 100 confidence points to spread across ten masked charts; league ranks by log score, so concentrating points raises both reward and risk.
hook: A budget puzzle on conviction.
risk: Points are not convertible to money; keep abstract.

name: Promotion Streak Protection
loop: Instead of day streaks, a four-week rolling average decides promotion; missing days simply reduces sample size and widens your band.
hook: No daily guilt, still meaningful rank.
risk: Weak retention loop by design; accept lower engagement.

name: Cross-Season Heirloom
loop: Finishing a season in a high division lets you pick one gentle rule modifier for the next, such as wider ranges or one extra skip, never extra score.
hook: Roguelike-style carry-over between seasons.
risk: Power creep; modifiers must be neutral or harder.

name: Seasonal Hot Seat
loop: Each week one league member takes the hot seat on a live-streamed round; friends watch the call arrive and predict whether it will be correct.
hook: Spectator tension within a friend group.
risk: Public pressure; opt-in only.

name: Rival Pairing Ladder
loop: Each day the ladder pairs you with a nearby rating; both answer the same chart, the closer forecast gains rating, shared by challenge link.
hook: Fair daily match with instant verdict.
risk: Matchmaking gaming; randomize within band.

name: Season With Seeded Chaos
loop: A friend league runs a season on generated paths whose rules the league votes on weekly, such as fatter tails or jumps, labelled synthetic.
hook: Governance fun; the group shapes the game.
risk: Synthetic skill may not transfer; label clearly.

name: Sandbag Detector Season
loop: Calibration rating requires your forecasts to be spread across the probability range; players who answer only near 50 percent are shown as unrated.
hook: Rating means something because gaming is blocked.
risk: May frustrate cautious beginners; explain clearly.

name: Weekend Mini League
loop: A two-day weekend league of ten quick charts for casual friends; Monday morning shows the table and a one-line recap for each person.
hook: Low-commitment weekend social event.
risk: Hit rate luck; use thirty calls minimum for prizes-free honours.

name: Division Banners
loop: Each division has a banner design that the members vote to change weekly; promoted players carry their old banner as a patch.
hook: Identity and tradition within divisions.
risk: Offensive designs; use fixed preset palettes.

name: Live Delayed Season
loop: Forecast the direction of delayed live prices over the next week; resolution arrives later and updates your seasonal rating retroactively.
hook: Real market uncertainty with waiting suspense.
risk: Near-live data looks like trading signals; keep delay and masks.

name: Next-Day Season Table
loop: Each evening call tomorrow's close direction for one masked index-like basket with a probability; friends see results next morning in a running table.
hook: Tiny nightly habit and morning reveal.
risk: Daily compulsion; one call only, no streak rewards.

name: Season Without Winners
loop: Friend leagues show only personal calibration curves and gentle trend lines, no rank order, with a weekly nudge on which discipline to improve.
hook: Self-improvement without the pressure of ranks.
risk: Weak competitive pull; offer optional rank toggle.

name: Veteran Mentor Pairing
loop: High-division players are paired with rookies as mentors; mentor score includes the rookie's calibration improvement over the season.
hook: Prestige from helping others.
risk: Adults only and no private contact; in-app notes only.

name: Season Draft Of Rules
loop: Before each season the club drafts three rule cards from a deck, for example wider ranges or skip-one-chart, shaping that season for all members.
hook: Deck-building flavour at the group level.
risk: Complex setup; offer defaults.

name: Seasonal Return To Mean
loop: At each season end ratings are pulled 40 percent toward the field average and bands are widened, so each season's race starts open yet history stays visible.
hook: Replay value from a regular fresh start.
risk: Veteran frustration; keep lifetime stats page.

name: Pantheon Of Seasons
loop: A pantheon page lists past season winners by calibration with their anonymised handles and seasonal best call; rank is for honour only.
hook: Legacy and aspiration.
risk: Exposed handles; opt-in listing.

name: Paper Fund League
loop: Weekly: split virtual points across five masked asset paths in a 3-minute round; friend league ranks by risk-adjusted paper return, with drawdown shown.
hook: Portfolio thinking in a safe sandbox.
risk: Allocation play resembles advice; synthetic labels required.

name: Seasonal Stat Sheets
loop: Each season gives a stat sheet in the app's own style: calls, calibration, interval honesty, with percent-only charts and zero on the axis, mirroring real profiles.
hook: Familiar look links the game to the main product.
risk: Confusing game stats with verified stats; distinct label.

name: Rookie Cup Fortnight
loop: Two-week onboarding cup for new players; each day unlocks a harder chart tier, finishing in a rookie placement into the main ladder.
hook: Structured onboarding with a goal date.
risk: Gradual unlocks might push excess play; cap daily rounds.

name: Pit Of Overconfidence
loop: Survive as many consecutive charts as possible with log-score budget; confident wrong calls drain a life meter, with the season best on a table.
hook: Roguelike tension and clear fail state.
risk: Chasing runs encourages binge play; session cap.

name: Seasonal Open Mic
loop: Weekly open session where any club can watch another club's anonymous call distribution live, then see how it resolves and learn from the split.
hook: Community drama around disagreement.
risk: Pile-ons; show only aggregated bars.

name: Season Gravity Rule
loop: Rating gains shrink as you climb: high divisions need longer samples, so luck-driven spikes get discounted and the top table is stable.
hook: Trustworthy summit, hard-earned.
risk: Slow climb feels grindy; show progress band.

name: Backwards Season
loop: Themed history season in which known past events are shown by name after the call; before the call only the chart appears, then a short factual caption.
hook: Learn market history through forecasting.
risk: Named events may involve companies; use generic labels.

name: Crowd Median Cup
loop: The league forms a median forecast per chart; each member scores their edge over the league median, so adding independent information, not agreement, wins.
hook: Social benchmark with a clear mathematical meaning.
risk: Small leagues make medians noisy; minimum size five.

name: Quarterly Grand Final
loop: The top division finishes the season with one longer five-minute final of twenty charts, same set for all, live-started at set times; others spectate.
hook: Big event moment to close each season.
risk: Scheduled events pressure attendance; replay available.

name: Seasonal Friend Awards
loop: After each week friends award each other peer badges for qualities like best reasoning or bravest honest range; badges appear on the season recap.
hook: Warm social recognition beyond scores.
risk: Popularity contests; fixed badge list, no free text.

name: Handicap League
loop: Friends of mixed skill play with handicaps from their rating so a beginner's calibration improvement can beat a veteran's flat result.
hook: Mixed-ability groups stay fun.
risk: Handicaps may be exploited; derive automatically.

name: Season Of Counterfactuals
loop: After each call you replay the same chart with a shifted window and see how your probability would have scored; season records robustness of your habits.
hook: Teaches that one outcome is not skill.
risk: Over-explaining; keep to one extra screen.

name: Climbing Wall Of Tiers
loop: Tiers named by generic ranks; each tier unlocks a harder chart feature, such as gaps or low liquidity, and a tougher peer group each season.
hook: Visible difficulty progression.
risk: Harder tiers could push risk-seeking; keep teaching tone.

name: Season Pause Right
loop: Every player gets two pause weeks per season that freeze rating and band, so holidays, illness or breaks never relegate anyone.
hook: Healthy rhythm and trust.
risk: Pause abuse; cap at two.

name: Open Position Season
loop: Keep a few open forecasts that resolve over weeks, shown as open items like open positions on profiles; the season counts all, none can be hidden.
hook: Mirrors the app's no-hiding record rules.
risk: Long-open items may feel like trades; label forecasts.

name: Anti-Bias Divisions
loop: Rounds are balanced so half rise and half fall; the table shows an up-bias dial, and top divisions require staying within a neutral zone on that dial.
hook: Reward even-handedness, which is rare.
risk: Constraints seem arbitrary; show dial live.

name: Clubhouse Chat Prompts
loop: Club members answer one canned multiple-choice debate question per day about a masked chart, with preset reaction options, no free chat.
hook: Safe, lightweight daily conversation.
risk: Reduced expressiveness; moderation cost near zero.

name: Season Seed Sharing
loop: Any player can publish a season seed as a link; others play the identical chart set and appear on that seed's private table for a week.
hook: User-made leagues spread by link.
risk: Seeds may leak outcomes; chart IDs hashed.

name: Grand Season Archive
loop: After the season you can replay highlights as a swipe deck of your best and worst calls with a one-line lesson on each.
hook: Reflective ritual closing the season.
risk: Low risk; ensure the deck never implies advice.

name: Reverse Promotion
loop: Bold variant: the worst-calibrated player of each division gets a coach seat next season, shown a guided mode that explains each miss.
hook: Turns last place into a learning path.
risk: May stigmatize; make it opt-in.

name: Confidence Stake Pool
loop: Bold variant: each friend stakes season points into a shared pool; league winners split the pool by log score, points never convert to money.
hook: Loss-aversion drama among friends.
risk: Stake mechanic mimics betting; probably unsafe, filter.

name: Real Record Shadow Season
loop: Bold variant: connected traders see a shadow league scoring how their paper calls compared with their verified records, kept private by default.
hook: Links game skill to real record honesty.
risk: Mixing game and verified data may mislead; strict separation.

name: Elimination Season
loop: Bold variant: a battle-royale season where the worst-scoring tenth each week are out until next season while spectators remain.
hook: High stakes narrowing to a final.
risk: Exclusion loops and churn; likely filtered.

name: Guild Territory Map
loop: Clubs capture regions of a stylised map by winning daily rounds in themed regions; season ends with the map recap and no persistent owner.
hook: Strategic team layer over solo rounds.
risk: Territory pressure on daily play; weekly cap.

name: Prediction Market Of Points
loop: Bold variant: league members trade abstract probability shares on weekly questions about delayed prices; final season rating from points, no cash-out.
hook: Market mechanics as a teaching tool.
risk: Reads as a betting market; strong policy risk.

name: Seasonal Replay Theatre
loop: Watch an end-of-season highlight reel of the league's most divided calls, predict along with the crowd bars, and see your agreement score.
hook: Passive low-effort social viewing.
risk: Low risk; ensure anonymised calls.

name: Calibration Passport
loop: Each season stamps a passport page with a themed drill and your reliability curve; collecting stamps from all themes in a year completes it.
hook: Collection meta across seasons.
risk: Completionist pressure; no expiry on stamps.

name: Daily Brief League
loop: A one-minute daily quiz on a concept or chart-reading question; correct answers add to a friend league table that resets monthly.
hook: Micro-session with friendly competition.
risk: Quiz content must avoid advice; reviewed bank.

name: Season Wager Of Habits
loop: Each player sets a private season habit goal, like never exceeding 90 percent confidence; the recap shows if they kept their own rule.
hook: Self-set discipline challenge with friends cheering.
risk: Low risk; goal list preset.

name: Dual Track Rating
loop: Two ratings: calibration (main) and paper return (secondary, shown smaller); promotion needs a calibration floor so lucky paper gains cannot lift you.
hook: Both fun and honest skills tracked.
risk: Paper return can lure risk-taking; keep secondary.

name: Seasonal Mastery Trials
loop: Pass weekly trials to hold a mastery level for the season: three trials on calibration, range honesty and bias; failing just means retrying next week.
hook: Clear pass or fail goals, no ranking.
risk: Low risk; ensure retry is unlimited but time-limited.

name: Neighborhood League
loop: Workplaces or clubs create adult-only leagues via invite codes; each shows a season table and an anonymous aggregate calibration versus other groups.
hook: Group identity and inter-group bragging.
risk: Workplace pressure; keep voluntary and anonymous.

name: Season In A Deck
loop: Each week draw a hand of 5 forecasting tool cards, like extra hint or range widener, and play 10 charts; rating moves with calibration and hand difficulty.
hook: Deck variety makes each week different.
risk: Cards could become paid items; never monetise.

name: Adaptive Division Chart Set
loop: Charts are chosen to maximise information about each player's skill, so everyone faces tailored difficulty yet rank uses a common scale.
hook: Always challenged, never overwhelmed.
risk: Opaque selection; publish the method.

name: Season Of Disagreement
loop: Only charts where your friends disagree most are served; settling who was right builds a friend-versus-friend head-to-head tally across the season.
hook: Maximum banter per chart.
risk: Conflict between friends; frame as friendly.

name: Rating Weather
loop: Your rating is displayed as a forecast-style band, such as likely range for next week, turning an own-skill uncertainty into a daily weather card.
hook: Fun, honest framing of skill noise.
risk: Might be read as market weather; label clearly.

name: Milestone Seasons
loop: Every fourth season is a special anniversary season that mixes every previous theme; the recap card compares your first and latest calibration.
hook: Long-term arc and a payoff for staying.
risk: Retention hook; no penalty for skipping seasons.

name: Coach Mode Leagues
loop: One member per week acts as league coach: sets the theme and writes a short debrief of the league's biggest bias after results, with a vote on usefulness.
hook: Rotating leadership engages everyone.
risk: Free text moderation; template debriefs.

name: Verified Meets Practice
loop: Season recap compares your forecasting calibration with the aggregate calibration of verified traders' public records, always in separate panels and percent-only.
hook: Bridges game and the product's core purpose.
risk: Appearing to rank users against traders; keep aggregate only.
